interpolation.magnitude: density-first linear between adjacent magnitude bins
interpolation.posterior: symmetric UNMASKED densities; P = rho_NEO / sum_c rho_c formed AFTER interpolation

abstention.rule: TECHNICAL FAILURES ONLY -> NaN, never 0 or 1
abstention.no_support_gate: per-pixel occupancy masking and standardized-Z gating are both REJECTED

operating_thresholds_from_CAL.basis: out-of-fold Platt predictions on CAL; pi_CAL = 0.7318%
operating_thresholds_from_CAL.PRIOR_CAVEAT: These thresholds TARGET 5% and 10% contamination UNDER pi_CAL = 0.7318%. TEST contamination is NOT guaranteed to equal those values: TEST has its own class fraction and its own score distribution. Any difference is a RESULT, not an error.

NO_RETUNING: TEST thresholds WILL NOT BE RETUNED. The three thresholds above are applied to TEST UNCHANGED. No parameter, transform, threshold, interpolation choice, mask, or map may be modified after TEST is viewed. TEST is scored ONCE.

datasets.TEST_status_at_seal_time: SEALED -- verified not drawn and not inspected

prior_transfer.assumption: LABEL SHIFT: p(X|y) unchanged between CAL and target; only p(y) differs. Invalid under covariate shift, a different detection/linking pipeline, or a non-NEOMOD3 target.

priors.pi_ref_caveat: pi_ref = 0.533% is an OVERLAP-WEIGHTED DENSITY-INTEGRAL ESTIMATE: the 667 maps are 30-deg patches at 10-deg spacing, so sky is multiply counted. The 27% difference from pi_CAL must NOT be read as a definitive physical prior mismatch without a non-overlapping, area-weighted recomputation.
